thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 10/16/2018: ADBE, MRVL, PLUG, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 10/16/2018: ADBE, MRVL, PLUG, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: +1.49%
AAPL: +0.85%
IBM: +0.46%
CSCO: +1.43%
GOOG: +0.71%
Technology stocks were advancing in early Tuesday trading.
Early movers include:
(+) Adobe Systems ( ADBE ), which was up nearly 6% after the company said it is on track to achieve Q4 fiscal year 2018 revenue of $2.42 billion and EPS of $1.42 on a GAAP-basis, and $1.87 on a non-GAAP basis, as well as meet other financial metrics it targeted for the quarter, excluding the impact of its pending acquisition of Marketo.
(+) Plug Power ( PLUG ) was up more than 4% as the fuel cell technology company increased full-year revenue guidance to a range of $175 million to $190 million from a prior range of $155 million to $180 million.
(+) Marvell Technology Group ( MRVL ) was more than 2% higher after announcing a $700 million addition to the balance of its existing share repurchase program, increasing the total current repurchase authority to $1 billion.
